note: hu.wikipedia.org's Mezőkeresztes-Mezőnyárád–Bükkábrány-vasútvonal article documents the real line at Bükkábrány as MAV line '280q' (not '371'), explicitly describing it as an 'iparvágany-szeru' (industrial-siding-like) short branch serving the Bükkalja lignite open-pit mine's electrified industrial siding. Two independent reasons to reject: (1) the documented code is 280q, not 371, matching the same code-mismatch pattern found in pair:29939:306 and pair:14155:268; (2) even setting the code mismatch aside, the line is explicitly documented as industrial mine-siding infrastructure, which review-policy.json excludes from domain scope regardless of code.
